summary.text: Matthew Alexander is the Republican candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democrat Kathryn Green.
A business owner and Cañon City Schools board director, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign focuses on fiscal responsibility, parental rights and constitutional freedoms.

paragraphs.text: Alexander defeated Michelle Gray in the June 30, 2026 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists a high school diploma from Verona Area High School and coursework at Madison Area Technical College in 1996.

In a Ballotpedia survey, the candidate's biography states that he is a fourth-generation Coloradan born in Alamosa and long a resident of Cañon City, has owned and operated Moon Rock Landscaping for two decades, and has served as a school board director for Cañon City Schools since 2023.
It also lists past work as a certified nursing assistant, retail manager, purchasing agent, sales manager and pastor, and three terms as chairman of the Headstart Policy Council.
Alexander's survey lists parental rights and education, protecting TABOR and cutting regulations, and Second Amendment and rural concerns as his key messages.
